name: Baber Arjumand
headline: Software Engineer | Frontend Lead | Full-Stack
tagline: Software Engineer & Technical Leader — React · TypeScript · Node.js · Go

summary.label: Summary
summary.text: Software engineer and technical leader with over 6 years building production web and mobile products across the full stack, in roles from Frontend Lead to CTO. Shipped cross-border payment, Web3, and AI conversational commerce products with fully remote teams across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and the Gulf.

bullets: Own product and engineering for a marketplace matching students with private Quran teachers across booking, scheduling, and onboarding.
Direct growth operations for a remote-first tutoring network, including teacher vetting and search visibility.
Architected a B2B cross-border payment platform from concept to alpha in 8 months using React and Tailwind CSS.
Engineered Node.js, Express, and MongoDB services with Python microservices for financial reporting.
Integrated Mastercard Digital Asset Solutions and shipped a real-time multi-branch liquidity dashboard with CI/CD on Firebase and Heroku.
Shipped AI conversational commerce features in React across 3 channels: WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Discord.
Built Go and PostgreSQL services on AWS for high-concurrency messaging workflows.
Migrated the unified customer inbox from Redux to Jotai and built engagement analytics with Datadog monitoring.
Directed frontend architecture for a Web3 social platform verifying cross-chain assets and NFTs.
Migrated a legacy Angular codebase to React and Next.js, improving load performance, SEO, and scalability.
Engineered multi-wallet authentication ahead of WalletConnect and led a distributed frontend team.
Led frontend delivery in Angular and React across concurrent client accounts as senior technical consultant.
Engineered NestJS APIs and ArangoDB data models; authored SRS documents and development roadmaps.
Directed 4 technical functions — web engineering, UI/UX, IT infrastructure, and digital marketing — across concurrent client work.
Supervised offshore React, Angular, Node.js, and WordPress delivery; owned budgets, QA, and technical hiring.
Set technical strategy and converted business requirements into Agile sprint plans.
Governed the delivery lifecycle and administered enterprise IT infrastructure and web services.

items.role: Full Stack Engineer, then Frontend Developer
bullets: Delivered full-stack applications spanning React and Angular frontends, REST APIs, and schema optimization.
Shipped Ionic apps with in-app subscriptions; configured CI/CD on AWS, Heroku, and Firebase.
Architected an Angular frontend and Spring Boot backend on AWS EC2 with Amplify CI/CD.
Integrated Stripe Connect for a vendor marketplace and ran intern workshops.
Built an on-demand laundry marketplace in Ionic for iOS and Android, from concept to alpha.
Engineered a serverless Firebase backend with internationalization for multi-region launch.
Deliver brand sites, e-commerce, and food-delivery systems for small and mid-sized businesses.
Build with React and Node.js alongside WordPress, Webflow, and Squarespace, integrating payments and CRM.
